STRATEGIC PLANNING: • Develops stewardship strategies for key donors and gifts to the University, working collaboratively with Senior Development Leadership on their respective area program plans. Partners closely with the Senior Director. • Develops a central, comprehensive stewardship plan for key donor constituencies, including, but not limited to Gold Circle Society, Trustees, and Lancaster Society. • Performs regular analyses to assess the effectiveness of overall strategies. • Develops innovative, unique and personalized donor relations/stewardship communications and engagement experiences for major donors. • Stays abreast of current and emerging trends in donor stewardship, philanthropy, fundraising, and higher education in order to make recommendations for DRS. PROJECT MANAGEMENT: • Manages the endowed fund reporting cycles using sophisticated knowledge of donor audience and financial data for endowed funds. • Manages annual stewardship portfolios and cycles, including impact reports, and fellowship, scholarship and programmatic stewardship.. • Develops and drives stewardship reporting cycles by proactive collaboration, follow-up and seeing projects through to their completion. • Takes on management of new projects under the direction of the Senior Director.

1-3 years of experience in communicating exceptionally well through verbal and written mediums, paying close attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in reporting as well as management of key processes.

REPORTING: • Produces reports for unit-based and central fundraising programs, reviewing current and past stewardship trends; makes recommendations for future stewardship programs accordingly. • Takes the lead on researching endowed and current-use funds, probing for fund expenditures, market values, etc. in order to enhance our endowed fund reporting process and communication. • Partners with Development Officers to obtain stewardship letters from faculty, deans, students and campus administrators for the purposes of impact reporting. • Develops, reviews, evaluates and modifies reports and reporting procedures to enhance donor relations and stewardship functions. • Provides expert internal consultation for development staff related to stewardship reporting and donor experiences. • Performs complex and high-level data analysis to inform and support data-driven decision making within the development community. DATA ANALYTICS: • Develops & analyzes key donor metrics and provides insight and recommendations to inform and expand donor stewardship and engagement programs. • Reviews data for the purposes of developing strategic donor stewardship, evaluating a combination of quantitative and qualitative data. • Generates and analyzes broad data sets, searches for explanations and underlying causes, draws conclusions and develops actionable recommendations. • Frequently collaborates with the Offices of Prospect Management and Research (PMATS) and Advancement Services, including Gift Administration, to trouble-shoot and resolve data-related issues and policies.
1-3 years of demonstrated expertise in writing, including excellent grammar, composition and proof-reading skills.
Must think critically, make informed decisions and demonstrate sound judgement.

Trains and supervises support staff and/or student assistants, as and when needed, to support major DRS processes around stewardship reporting and analysis. • Serves as liaison between DRS and key administrators, faculty and staff with regard to donor stewardship, including the management of monthly meetings for a DRS liaison group. • Implements policies around donor stewardship and reporting protocols.

Covered Individuals: A Covered Individual includes anyone designated as Personnel or Students under this Policy who physically access a University Facility or Program in connection with their employment, appointment, or education/training. A person accessing a Healthcare Location as a patient, or an art, athletics, entertainment, or other publicly accessible venue at a Location as a member of the public, is not a Covered Individual.
Ability to analyze problems/issues of diverse scope and determine solutions.
Ability to multi-task successfully in a fast-paced and evolving environment with demanding timeframes.
